title: Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Enhanced Root Mean Square Error (ERMSE): Deep Learning for Stock Price Movement Prediction
label_definition: Predict closed stock price; directional trend is evaluated as 0 if y_t - y_{t-1} < 0, 1 if y_t - y_{t-1} > 0, and previous trend if y_t - y_{t-1} = 0.
data_requirements: Use Yahoo Finance CSV data for DJIA covering 1 Jan 2013 to 31 Dec 2018.
Use stock data fields described as date, open, low, high, close, and volume.
Input to the proposed model is normalized data.
training_protocol: Train the proposed GAN on normalized Yahoo Finance CSV stock-index data. The generator G is based on LSTM, the discriminator D is based on CNN, and the reported GAN configuration uses window size 121, 100 epochs, 25 hidden layers, and 1 output. Optimizer, batch size, chronological train/test split, seed, and convergence rule are unknown.
evaluation_protocol: Evaluate the proposed GAN against the state-of-the-art LSTM baseline on the DJIA row using directional accuracy, processing time, and MRSE/RMSE. The exact chronological split and context overlap are unknown.
strict_requirements: Use the proposed GAN model, not the state-of-the-art LSTM baseline.
Use DJIA as the selected single result row.
Use Yahoo Finance stock-index CSV data from 1 Jan 2013 to 31 Dec 2018.
Use normalized data as model input.
Report the DJIA proposed-model metrics exactly as directional accuracy 64.58%, processing time 125 Sec, and MRSE 0.0280.
unknowns: Exact prediction horizon length and unit are not reported in the supplied context.
